report: 1. Resident A is experiencing increased pain levels despite current pain management interventions. Resident appears to be more fatigued and is having difficulty with mobility. Further assessment needed to optimize pain control and comfort measures.

5. Resident E's family has expressed concerns about resident's overall decline and quality of life. Collaboration with the interdisciplinary team is needed to develop a plan of care that aligns with resident's wishes and goals for care in the palliative setting. Open communication and support for family members are essential in providing holistic care for resident E.
Resident A presented with increased pain and discomfort today. Provided extra pain medication as needed. Resident's family was informed and updates were given on a regular basis.
Resident B appears fatigued and has had decreased appetite over the past 24 hours. Offered nutrition support and encouraged fluids. Will continue to monitor closely for any changes in condition.
Resident C's pain levels seem to be well-managed with current medication regimen. Family was pleased with resident's comfort level during visit. Will continue to assess and adjust as necessary.
